description: Track a payment you received and calculate your sales tax liability. Call this after receiving any payment — Stripe, x402, or direct. Calculates tax owed and logs it to your AgentTax account (requires API key for history). Pass work_type when you know what you sold, for an exact answer; it is the only way to get the consulting exemption (AI consulting is exempt in Arizona) or the trading exemption. Without it the sale is classified from description: a description that looks like consulting or trading is taxed as SaaS, never exempt; one that looks like compute or research keeps that classification, which can tax less than SaaS in some states (e.g. CT, MD, SC, TN, WV).

buyer_state.description: 2-letter US state where the buyer is located (e.g. TX, NY, CA)

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's 5-digit zip code for local tax rates (more precise)

description.description: What you sold (e.g. 'API access', 'MCP tool subscription', 'compute credits'). Used only when work_type is not given; a guess never takes the consulting or trading exemption

is_b2b.description: Buyer is a business (affects rates in MD, IA, NJ, OH). Omit if unknown: false declares a consumer

payment_id.description: Your payment reference ID (Stripe payment_intent ID, x402 receipt, invoice number); letters, digits and _-.:@ only

work_type.description: What you sold, declared: compute, research, information_service, content, consulting, trading. Overrides description. consulting is an exempt professional service in Arizona

name: track_payment
title: Track a payment you received
